verdict.rationale: Restate is a durable-execution platform, and a built-in assistant in its UI or Cloud console would be a plausible feature, so the axis applies. The evidence does not show one. The 'AI assistant' docs describe a plugin, documentation and an MCP integration that teach external coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to build Restate apps. The AI-agent pages describe patterns for users building their own agents on Restate. Neither is an assistant inside the product that users can hand tasks to.
